newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens at a new peak after Dow surge.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens at a new peak after Dow surge.

text.p: UK's benchmark FTSE 100 index climbed further into record ground at the open on Wednesday, buoyed by another solid performance on Wall Street and news of a possible bid for Energy Group Plc , dealers said.
At 0740 GMT, the blue chip index was up 19.0 points to 4,758.6, as advancers outpaced decliners by a margin of three-to-one.

Shares in Energy Group led the advance, soaring 76p, or more than 13 percent, to 656 after the UK electricity concern late Tuesday said it was in talks with PacifiCorp of the U.S. which could lead to a recommended offer.
